title: Curse and Blessing on Mount Ebal and Mount Gerizim
description: After the victory over Ai, Joshua built an altar of uncut stones on Mount Ebal and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. He wrote a copy of the Mosaic Law on the stones, and all Israel stood in two groups on either side of the Ark of the Covenant—half facing Mount Gerizim and half facing Mount Ebal. Joshua then read aloud all the words of the law, both the blessings and the curses, to the entire assembly.
